subtitle: Table of Contents, Core Equations, and the Canonical Dependency Graph

blocks.text: This chapter presents the poster “Geometry of Persisting — Beyond Life (Jacket & Contents)” in full. It is a single dense diagram; open it, then use the explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools beneath it to work through the ideas at your own pace.

blocks.caption: Figure 5.1 — Geometry of Persisting — Beyond Life (Jacket & Contents): Table of Contents, Core Equations, and the Canonical Dependency Graph.
blocks.explanation: The book jacket in its portrait form: the front panel carries the invariant intent motif, I in Sigma, with the realization operator and the persistence functional set on either side of it, and beneath, the chain of persistence media — neuron, brain, tablet, book, archive, network. The reverse panel carries the full table of contents across eight parts, the five core equations of the volume (the invariance condition, the persistence functional, the stationary intent principle, the intent Lagrangian, and the informal statement of the invariance theorem), and the canonical dependency graph running from foundations through the semantic manifold, intent, intent dynamics, realization theory, persistence theory, civilizational persistence, deep-time persistence and cosmic persistence to the non-dual limit. The four-glyph progression at the foot — existence, stability, invariance, transcendence — is the trilogy's arc compressed to a single line.
